sv.title: Nvidias krisdrag: Formar exportkommitté
sv.summary: Chipjätten Nvidias styrelse har format en kommitté för nationell säkerhet och exportkontroll (National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee). Det framgår av ett pressmeddelande från bolaget.

en.title: Nvidia's crisis move: forms export committee
en.summary: Chip giant Nvidia's board has formed a committee for national security and export control oversight (National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee). This is according to a press release from the company.
